artifactType: research scratch setup Git pointer incident receipt
status: incident-only; native failure patch/replay work stopped on parent instruction
cause: Scratch setup linked each top-level regular file from the source tree, including .git, then Path.write_text on the scratch .git symlink followed it and overwrote the active worktree pointer. This crossed the .git read-only boundary.

preincidentEvidence.inferenceBasis: The common worktree metadata directory /workspace/adnd1/.git/worktrees/adnd1-next-source-native contains a gitdir file pointing back to /workspace/adnd1-next-source-native/.git. The actual source .git bytes were not read before writing, so this expected preimage is inferred, not captured.

corruptingWrite.operation: Path(tmp/'.git').write_text(f'gitdir: {src}/.git\n') while tmp/.git was a symlink to active /workspace/adnd1-next-source-native/.git
corruptingWrite.observedCommand: ls -l .git && cat .git && git rev-parse --show-toplevel && git rev-parse HEAD

rm -f /tmp/dmg175-native-failure-replay-v1/.git && python - <<'PY'

Path('/workspace/adnd1-next-source-native/.git').write_text('gitdir: /workspace/adnd1/.git/worktrees/adnd1-next-source-native\n')
Path('/tmp/dmg175-native-failure-replay-v1/.git').write_text('gitdir: /workspace/adnd1/.git/worktrees/adnd1-next-source-native\n')
PY
git rev-parse --show-toplevel && git rev-parse HEAD && git rev-parse --git-dir
